about: The skin's own page surface as the specs reach it (D77): every name a spec reads off an element the skin draws — a class, an attribute — stands here once, under a stable id, with what the reader sees there. A rename in the skin is one line of this file; lint holds every name to a literal the browser half writes and every entry to a spec that reads it.

surface.sees: the page the skin is applied to: every stylesheet the skin ships is scoped under this mark on <body>
the motion the reader asked for, resolved: the stylesheets still every animation under its reduced value
the page's own scale, resolved: every length the skin writes is divided by it, and the stylesheets draw the page at it
the part a host element plays, written by the parts walk; a mechanism spec that builds a host node marks it under this name rather than spelling it
a conversation row that has been laid out at its real size since it arrived or since the column last changed width: only such a row may be skipped while it stands off screen

the host's own number and the one this skin drew from it, kept on each box of the frame it carried — the frame's column list, the sidebar's own width, the sidebar handle's place: a second copy of the rule on the page reads the box as already carried
a skin menu card standing open: the stylesheet shows the card while it reads true
the usage panel's heat grid, one square per day
one day's square; hovering it shows that day's tip pill
the words of a day's tip pill
the effort level's text inside the composer's seat box: the second of the row's two texts, with a card of its own
the effort picker's card, with its slider of strengths
the pixel crab standing on the composer's top edge
the animation the mascot is playing, named as its sheet is
the window the crab's current frame shows through: the frame's crop box, clipping the rest of its sheet
the crab's whole sheet, moved inside its window frame by frame; it paints the colour sheet and its ::after the ink mask
the floating panel the effort card sits in: the box the seat's right edge anchors, opened and closed by data-open
the box the composer's seat shares: the model's name and the effort level as one row item, whose right end is the edge both cards hang from

the model's name inside the seat box: it swaps to the picked model's name in place, the words it leaves rising through a blur as the new ones come up, with both names holding the seat's right edge so neither slides while the box travels
one copy of a line that swaps in place: the words leaving and the words arriving stand in the same box while the swap runs
the composer's row of controls, the part walk's mark on the host row: the width the model name and its neighbours share
the hint the skin draws in the composer card where the host draws none, over an empty field: the shell's words in the field's caption ink
the conversation root while one of its views other than the chat is selected: the composer's whole bottom area stands down
the conversation root while a message column is mounted on the page: the stylesheet holds the composer on the scrollport's bottom edge from this mark as it does from the host's active phase
one dot of the animated matrix the strongest rung shows
the slider's track: the groove the reader drags or clicks to pick a level, one stop per effort
the slider's knob: the handle that rides the track and rests on the level in force
the name of the level the slider shows: the one under the pointer while a drag runs, the committed one otherwise
the line of statistics under the composer card: turns, speed, tokens, the session's cost and the cache share
the session's cost on the line, four decimals and a currency symbol, between the written-back tokens and the cache share
the host's context popover while it stands open, marked by the skin: the host's rows above the session's numbers, opened by the meter and by the line under the composer
the host's context popover once the skin has placed it: the stylesheet reads the two edges written beside this mark
the host's context meter in the dock the host renders it in, marked by the skin: the button whose press opens the host's context popover, and the reading's own text where no projection answers
the ring the skin draws in the composer row, after the seat box: the occupancy as a ring or a pie in the colour band it fell on, and the number beside it
which colour band a reading follows — the cache share's or the context occupancy's (features/context-stats/stats-ramp.ts)
the segment of that band the reading fell in, `low` and `high` naming the ends
a meter whose reading is drawn as a pie: its own circle stands down under the plate the feature paints
the host's account menu while it stands open, drawn as the skin's own menu card: the account header, the settings row and the plugin rows
the model picker's second level: the providers the first level does not list, with a search field above them
the search field at the top of the second level: the reader types a model's name into it and the list under it narrows
the control that clears the search field, drawn while the field holds words
one model row of the second level, under its provider's label
the caret the skin draws in place of the browser's own, on the surface holding the focus
the provider's name above its models in the second level
the field a press on the header's session title opens, standing over the words it renames with the name the session list carries
the tip the pointer over the session title raises under the words, naming what a press on the name does
